Case note: Com. S. No. 378/2021
Client: Suresh Kulkarni (shopkeeper, Kozhikode)
Opposing party: M/s Patel Infotech Pvt Ltd
Court: Kozhikode Commercial Court
Filed on: 8 May 2021
Claim amount: Rs. 6,40,00,000
Issue: breach of contract. The goods supplied were defective.
Advice given: Claim liquidated damages as fixed in the contract.
Outcome: The claim for liquidated damages was allowed.
Recommended next step: Recover the damages from the security deposit.
Matter code: Project Heron
